sections.heading: tyBooleanModifier
sections.content: ThetyBooleanmodifier is a modifier capable of performing boolean CSG operations on a mesh. It can often provide results that contain less artifacts than boolean operations performed with 3ds Max’s default boolean modules. It will also take the reference object’s animated transformation changes into effect when performing its operations.

sections.heading: Engine
sections.content:
